written_before_outcomes: writing started 2026-10-20T23:08:34Z (date -u), before any outcome of this campaign; no label read, no real-data computation, no label-reading loader called
implementation: frc/rules.py (pure functions; load_rules() checks this file against the module constants and the NRM1 rule file hash); invented-data tests: python3 -m frc.test_rules (prints JSON; exit 0 iff all pass)
status_of_every_rule: development rule on previously and adaptively used records; changes no original limit; the reserve and the original capacity gate are reported, never gating; point feasibility is never called confidence preservation; every uncertainty statement is asymptotic and model-based

inherited.module: nrm.rules imported unchanged (aggregate screen, benefit / target / recipient screens, reserve_status, point_eligibility, frontier_comparison, reserve_frontier, claims G1-G7, select_candidate, reader_stability, robustness, alias_groups)

sign_convention: paired differences are loss(first) - loss(second) on the same people (negative favours the first); accuracy enters as a loss

qpe.difference: d_v = nested MODEL_FIT held-out per-person occupation NLL B1 - A (T1; 5 outer household folds NRM_FA_ncv_S<v>; household-clustered SE)
qpe.PE_ERROR_SUPPORTED: d_v + 2 SE_used_v < 0 for v = 0 and 1, and the MODEL_SELECT paired occupation NLL B1 - A (T3) < 0 at the point for v = 0 and 1
qpe.PE_ERROR_NOT_SUPPORTED: d_v >= 0 for some v (ties at 0 are not supported)
qpe.INCOMPLETE: a nested (estimate, SE) missing or non-finite; or the nested differences resolved and a MODEL_SELECT value missing
qpe.reported_beside: the same nested reading (RESOLVED_NEGATIVE_BOTH / POINT_NEGATIVE_BOTH / NOT_NEGATIVE_SOME_VERSION / MISSING) for inc_nll, tot_nll, occ_brier, inc_brier, occ_acc, inc_acc with MODEL_SELECT point values; men's and women's occupation Brier from MODEL_SELECT only (T1 reads no SEX); B0 - B1; share removed
qpe.share_removed: per version (spend_A - spend_B1) / spend_A of the nested occupation NLL spend over CONT, defined iff spend_A > 0; pooled = mean numerator / mean denominator; reported only
qpe.se_used: SE_used = max(household-clustered SE, sample SD of the 5 outer-fold means / sqrt(5)) per version and metric; fold means from nested[v]['folds'][i]['paired_fold_means'][metric] (or nested[v]['fold_means'][metric]); absent or not 5 finite values -> INCOMPLETE for the label (reported rows fall back to the household SE, flag FOLD_MEANS_MISSING_V<v>)

construction_choice.rule: per capacity, MODEL_FIT nested point estimates only: B1 iff the paired occupation NLL and the paired total (income + occupation) NLL B1 - A are both < 0 in both versions; otherwise A (ties at 0 go to A); total = inc + occ point estimates if tot_nll is not given (flag TOTAL_FROM_TASK_SUM)
construction_choice.use: the chosen construction is used consistently afterwards (QUAL, TWIN, PRC, HQ, SHUF, ORD, ablation); MODEL_SELECT never chooses it

qual.Q1: G1 of the version at the point: 12 clauses + 2 guards, original caps, inclusive (nrm.rules.point_eligibility)
qual.Q2: value <= cap - d for every condition of the version (inclusive; cap - d in double precision); d = the S2 budget (the assessment budget of D2)
qual.q2_increment_source: the S2 budget of FA_PRC_v1 (occ NLL 0.008, inc NLL 0.004, occ acc 0.006, inc acc 0.004, men's / women's guards 0.0030); summed Brier not budgeted by S2: occupation 0.0030 (guard budget), income 0.0020 (half the income NLL budget); both references U0 and Ucal (adjudication finding 1, adopted before any outcome; the S1 form of the 23:24Z freeze is superseded)
qual.qualified: Q1 and Q2 in both versions
qual.status: a gate for starting the comparison, not a claim; never confidence preservation; the reserve is reported separately
qual.known_before_registration: A at (16, 64) meets Q1, fails this Q2 (v1 men's guard 0.00255 + 0.0030 = 0.00555 > 0.005) and meets the superseded S1 form (0.00405); QUALIFIED_WITHOUT_PROBABILITY_REPAIR can occur only at (24, 128) or (32, 256)

original_capacity_gate.definition: FA_PRC_v1 section 4: nested held-out spend of the construction over CONT, estimate + 2 household-clustered SE, per task, per version
original_capacity_gate.pass: every metric of both versions passes

reproduction.rule: T1's A reproduces every number of the GATE record (nested_means CONT and twin, spend_twin_over_cont estimate and SE) within 1e-12 and the gate label; an existing capacity without a recorded passed reproduction is STOPPED_FOR_DIAGNOSIS

capacities.protection_capacity: the first capacity in order whose chosen construction is QUALIFIED; the construction is chosen per capacity (no circularity)
capacities.T5: only if neither existing capacity qualifies: 32x256 (nested A / B0 / B1, chosen construction, MODEL_SELECT utility, QUAL)
capacities.T6: only if 32x256 does not qualify: at most one structural repair, labelled POST_HOC, card committed before any MODEL_SELECT read of its outputs, judged by the same choice and QUAL rules; may be declined; gives only POST_HOC_REPAIR_QUALIFIED
capacities.stop: no task-only finite release qualifies: family FA stops and protected routing remains untested
capacities.untriggered_results: a 32x256 or repair result present without its trigger is ignored and flagged (T5_RESULT_WITHOUT_TRIGGER_IGNORED, REPAIR_WITHOUT_TRIGGER_IGNORED); a repair without a committed card is ignored (REPAIR_WITHOUT_COMMITTED_CARD_IGNORED)
capacities.record_other_construction: per capacity: the chosen construction and whether the other would have qualified (recorded, never used)

D1.rule: at the protection capacity: a T6 repair -> POST_HOC_REPAIR_QUALIFIED (never REPAIRED_TASK_ONLY_RELEASE); B1 chosen and PE_ERROR_SUPPORTED -> REPAIRED_TASK_ONLY_RELEASE; B1 chosen and PE_ERROR_POINT_ONLY -> QUALIFIED_B1_REPAIR_NOT_RESOLVED; A chosen -> QUALIFIED_WITHOUT_PROBABILITY_REPAIR; stop -> NO_QUALIFYING_TASK_ONLY_RELEASE; otherwise INCOMPLETE

D2.configuration: the PRC configuration selected at S2 (an alias of an earlier budget's selection is that configuration, with its brackets)
D2.rule: met (COMPONENT_BEYOND_MATCHED_CONTROLS) iff (a) G1; (b) vs TWIN: nrm.rules.comparison passes (AGG_POSITIVE pair benefit + recipient gate, both views, both versions); (c) nrm.rules.frontier_comparison == DOMINATES_CONTROL_FRONTIER against the control paths [SHUF_S2, SHUF_BR], [HQ_S2, HQ_BR] and [TWIN, distinct ORD_S1..S3, ORD_BR] (only points that exist, aliases once; an empty SHUF or HQ path is compared at [TWIN], flag <name>_AT_IDENTITY); (d) F4: nested held-out pair LOOKUP AUC_twin - AUC_prc minus 2 household-bootstrap SE > 0 in both versions; (e) reader targeting: against TWIN and every bracketing point Q* selected by frontier_comparison, the non-table (nolookup) pair winner's benefit > 0 in both version means AND the nested MODEL_FIT LOOKUP benefit AUC_control - AUC_prc > 0 in both versions
D2.labels: in order: NOT_COMPUTED_GRID_VALIDITY_UNKNOWN / NOT_COMPUTED_GRID_INVALID; NOT_ASSESSED_NO_FEASIBLE_STRENGTH; NOT_ASSESSED_EXACT_ALIAS (every nonzero selection transmits exactly the twin's vectors: the family stops); INCOMPLETE; NOT_MET_F4 (not a stop); READER_TARGETED (b and c all pass, e fails); COMPONENT_BEYOND_MATCHED_CONTROLS or MET_WITHOUT_TASK_FEASIBILITY (b-e pass, no G1); NO_REDUCTION_BEYOND_ANY_CONTROL; PARTIAL_<passed, joined by +, in the order TWIN, SHUF_FRONTIER, HQ_FRONTIER, ORD_FRONTIER>_ONLY; flags PRC_S2_ALIAS_OF_TWIN, <name>_AT_IDENTITY, READER_TARGETED_<comparison>, TWIN_NESTED_LOOKUP_FROM_F4; NOT_ASSESSED_PROTECTED_ROUTING_UNTESTED after a capacity stop
D2.partial: no partial outcome is a component claim
D2.power: minimum detectable pair benefit about 0.015 (2 se_agg); "not separated" is the default reading

decisions.D3: NRM1 G4 (all nine point-eligible references, intersection-union, recipient gates) at the D2 configuration, with reader_budget_rule_references: NOT_CREDITED -> NOT_SUPERIOR; INCOMPLETE -> INCOMPLETE
decisions.D4: NRM1 G5 (0.020 vs NEURAL_RAW and H_LJ; levels kept) at the D2 configuration, with reader_budget_rule_references for the two targets: NOT_CREDITED -> level NOT_MET; INCOMPLETE -> a level above NOT_MET becomes INCOMPLETE
decisions.D5: NOT_ASSESSED_MISSING_CONTROLS unless the separate design and both sequential orders exist (then NRM1 G6); ABL_LOC alone is not the D5 control set
decisions.reader_budget_rule_references: a reference comparison flagged READER_BUDGET_ASYMMETRIC (frc.readerbudget.contrast, pair view) is credited iff the NON-TABLE winner point benefit (the grid's nolookup extra vs that reference) is > 0 in both version means; the nested MODEL_FIT LOOKUP condition does not apply to references (never refitted on MODEL_FIT); missing nolookup inputs make that reference INCOMPLETE (never not beaten). Three-valued application (the rule only withdraws credit): NOT_CREDITED turns a met label into a failure; INCOMPLETE turns a met label into INCOMPLETE; a label already failing on its own results stays failing (incomplete references listed)

outcome_class.rule: CANDIDATE iff D2 met and D3 met; COMPONENT iff D2 met and D3 not; ENGINEERING_REPAIR iff D1 = REPAIRED_TASK_ONLY_RELEASE and D2 not met; FINITE_NEGATIVE_RESULT otherwise; INCOMPLETE if D1, D2 or D3 is incomplete or uncomputed for grid validity

strongest_nonzero.rule: among PRC configurations with lambda > 0, G1, not an alias (of an earlier configuration or ALIAS_ZERO vs TWIN), complete grid: the largest registered-cell aggregate pair benefit vs TWIN; ties (|dx| <= 1e-12) to the smaller lambda, then config_id; none -> NO_FEASIBLE_NONZERO_RELEASE
strongest_nonzero.status: descriptive; chosen on registered MODEL_SELECT cells (winner's curse); robustness cells and the ablation never change D1-D6

refit_effectiveness.rule: REFIT_GENUINELY_EFFECTIVE iff (a) R3 and R4 assignment hashes differ from each other and from R1 / R2, and every pairwise SCORE household overlap involving R3 or R4 is recorded, finite and in [0, 1); and (b) the FRC1 grid_validity holds on the eight seeds S<v>k<k>, k = 0..3, on the minimum set (strongest release and its matched controls); otherwise REFIT_NOT_GENUINELY_EFFECTIVE and the failed part's cells are counted once

reader_seeds.rule: recorded seeds S<v>k<k> = MODEL_SEED_BASE + 700 + 10 v + k exactly (k0, k1 registered; k2, k3 robustness), distinct integers, none equal to MODEL_SEED_BASE + {300, 400, 500, 600} + 10 v + k (k = 0..9); recipe-equality parts of A-SC1 as nrm.rules.grid_validity, unchanged

scope: Lower recovery for the declared development readers is not protection against every reader.
MODEL_SELECT is adaptively used: development evidence, never confirmation.
Versions share training rows; repetitions share households; reader recipes and overlapping splits are not independent datasets.
A reserve-frontier result is not superiority over every historical method.
Novelty is never inferred from performance.
Point feasibility, QUAL and the reserve are not confidence preservation.
